entities.name: Muqaddimah (Ibn Khaldun)
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Groundbreaking work by Ibn Khaldun (1377) on the philosophy of history. Introduced concepts of social cohesion (asabiyyah) and cyclical rise and fall of civilizations — foundational to sociology.
